name: CFO Command: Corporate Finance & Capital Allocation
description: Simulation placing participants in the role of CFO of a LATAM mid-cap industrial group. Teams calculate WACC from first principles, evaluate five competing investment opportunities using NPV and IRR, design an optimal capital structure while monitoring a live credit rating model, and release trapped working capital — integrating all decisions into a coherent capital allocation plan.
